original_benchmark.notes: PRBench Finance (Scale AI, arXiv 2511.11562): expert-written conversations graded against weighted rubric criteria by an LLM judge (o4-mini in the paper). finance_hard (300) is a subset of these records.
PRBench Legal. legal_hard (250) is a subset of these records.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle run (ORACLE_MODE=true) and nop run cover all 1100 tasks. Parity is planned on a 200-task subset (--split parity), 100 per domain, stratified by hard-subset membership and topic; not run yet.
